Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That’s it from this game! India Women have bagged the series with a game to go. The third T20I will be played on the 27th of June. The match is set to begin at 2.00 pm IST (8.30 am GMT). But as you all know our build-up will begin in advance. So, do join us then! Till then, good bye and take care.

Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women is also the Player of the Match. She says that she is happy to win the game and the series. Adds that the track was not easy to bat on, but they did well on this slow and turning track. Concludes by saying that it is important to stay calm, and she is happy that things went according to their plans.

Chamari Atapattu the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says that they did bat well but the last 6 overs did not go well for them. Adds that they were about 15 runs short and she says that Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana batted really well. On Vishmi Gunaratne, she says that she is young but she played well. Concludes by saying that they have a young team but they will improve.
Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, after electing to bat first, Sri Lanka Women got off to a brilliant start, courtesy of some fine stroke playing by their opening pair. But once they departed, wickets fell within no time. As a result, they ended up setting a below-par target of 126. Coming to the chase, they leaked runs in the beginning but fought back really well. Their spinners did control the middle phase and did exceptionally well to take it to the final over. However, 15-20 runs more and things could have been different!

The Lankan bowlers did not start that well with the ball but the spinners were quite impressive in the middle overs. At one stage, it seemed like India Women will end this game around the 16th or the 17th over but some very good bowling by Oshadi Ranasinghe and Inoka Ranaweera ensured it was not going to be that easy. However, they just did not have enough runs on the board and ended on the losing side of the game. A good effort though but it's their batting once again that has failed.

Quite a convincing win for India Women yet again! Sri Lanka Women just did not have enough on the board. They were at least 20 runs short of what would have been a competitive total. The openers set the tone with a quick-fire start and then it was about batting sensibly and the Indians did do so. Smriti Mandhana was the top scorer but it was Kaur who stayed there till the end and took her side over the line. There were a few little, little contributions from others too and that was enough for India to make it 2-0.

FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur finishes things off in style! Kavisha Dilhari tosses this one up, full in length, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary. India Women win by 5 wickets and have sealed the T20I series!
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! Loopy ball, on middle. Deepti Sharma looks to sweep this one but she gets a slight inside edge back onto her pads. 3 needed off the last 6 balls!
Around middle, fuller one. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up, on middle. Deepti Sharma clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Deepti Sharma flicks it toward deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur dabs it towards point for a single.
Down the leg side, length ball. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it to the fielder at short fine leg, who collects the ball on a bounce.
Fuller ball, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a run. 8 runs needed off the last two overs now!

Another mix-up but safe once again! Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma flicks it to square leg and they run across for a run. Harmanpreet Kaur wants a second run there, she leaves her crease but she is sent back in time.
Loopy one, full, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur once again sweeps this to deep square leg for a run.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Yastika Bhatia has to depart now! Lovely delivery! A fuller ball, outside off, loopy one as well. Yastika Bhatia dances down the track and tries to drive this but she misses. Anushka Sanjeewani once again grabs the ball and whips the bails off. Oshadi Ranasinghe grabs her second wicket and India Women have lost their fifth.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: A mix-up...but no harm done! Fuller one, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. They run the first one fast, and after a bit of yes and no they come back for the second one. However, Yastika Bhatia leaves her crease late, but the throw is well away from the bowler and towards covers. There is another throw once again, at the bowler's end but it's away from the stumps. The ball rolls away and the batters steal in an overthrow as well! Three run for India Women in total!

Leg bye! An appeal for LBW, but turned down! Fuller one, loopy ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to sweep this one but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad. The ball rolls towards point and the batters steal a leg bye!
Tad shorter, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur uses the depth of the crease and plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, fuller ball, Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards long off for a single.
Tosses this one up, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker, on the pads again, fullish ball. Harmanpreet Kaur advances down the track and tries to flick this but she misses.
Pitched up, darting it on the pads. Yastika Bhatia flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full again, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this towards deep square leg. The fielder there runs to her right, dives and cuts it out. Two taken!
Fuller one now, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it towards the left of the bowler. Oshadi Ranasinghe dives to her left and makes a good stop.
Outside off, short in length. Yastika Bhatia dabs it towards point for a single.
Pitched up, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur clears her front foot and drives it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Beaten! This one turns in, around middle and leg, fuller one. Yastika Bhatia leans to drive this but she gets beaten on the inside edge.
Back of a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia knocks it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Short now, on middle. Yastika Bhatia pushes it back to the bowler.
Good running! Full again, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it firmly towards deep cover and they come back for the second run. Harmanpreet Kaur dives in to make her ground.
Full now, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards mid off.
Another shorter one, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur clips this one towards square leg for another run.
Shorter ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
tight single! Outside off, short in length. Yastika Bhatia dabs it towards point and scampers across to the other end.
Full, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED! This is tossed up, full, around middle. Yastika Bhatia sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs forward, gets her hands to the ball, but spills it out at the end. Single taken! Yastika Bhatia gets a life!
Shortish ball, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards mid on.
Much fuller now, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, around off, spinning away a tad. Yastika Bhatia tries to push this away but she gets an under edge back onto the deck.
Shorter in length now, around middle. Yastika Bhatia punches it off the back foot towards long on for a single. 32 needed off 42 balls now!
On the pads now, fuller ball. Yastika Bhatia flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace. She gets off the mark straightaway!

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two overs for Inoka Ranaweera! This is a huge wicket as Jemimah Rodrigues is sent back. India Women have lost their fourth! Loopy ball, outside off, slower through the air as well. Jemimah Rodrigues leans to drive but the ball goes off the splice and towards point. Hasini Perera there takes a good catch!
Commentary.Howout: c Hasini Perera b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Another pitched up delivery, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes this one towards mid off. Three dots in a row now!
Tosses this one up, very full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives and finds the fielder at cover-point.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it out off the back foot.
On middle, Jemimah Rodrigues works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Two more! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
The sweep is out again, but it goe off the inner half towards short fine leg.
On middle, defended.
WIDE! Down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses.
Flatter ball, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it towards short fine leg.

OUT! STUMPED! A deserving wicket for Inoka Ranaweera! Smriti Mandhana departs after a good start! Another fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana dances down the track, yorks herself and fails to dig this one out. Anushka Sanjeewani collects the ball and whips the bails off. Jemimah Rodrigues is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Fuller, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans to drive this but she misses.
Outside off, shorter ball. Smriti Mandhana cuts it towards point.
Drifting it in, on the pads, fullish ball. Harmanpreet Kaur steps down the track and flicks this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full, around middle. Smriti Mandhana lifts it towards long on for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is the last thing Sri Lanka Women needed! A fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes inside-out towards deep cover. The fielder there runs towards the ball but fails to grab it. It goes behind her towards the ropes for a boundary.
Two more! On middle, this is flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Outside off, this is lofted over covers for a boundary.
On off, defended.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
No run.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! This is driven through covers, fuller and on off, it is caressed for a boundary.
On middle, defended.
Steps out and works this down to long on for one.
On middle, defended.
The sweep is out, it takes the top edge though but lands safe in the deep square leg region for one.
On off, blocked.
A single now as this is guided through point.
On middle, this is blocked to the left of the bowler and a run is taken. Excellent run.

Was that a chance? Very, very difficult! This lands on off and turns away. Smriti Mandhana looks to defend, it goes off the outside edge but hits the outer part of the pad of the keeper and goes behind for one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On off, this is guided to point.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for another single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter and outside off, Smriti Mandhana guides it past point and this races away to the fence.
Another dot as this is pushed to cover.
Flatter and angling away. Mandhana looks to cut but misses.
BEATEN! Flatter and outside off, Kaur looks to guide it past point but misses.
FOUR! That is wonderfully timed! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for a boundary. Lovely shot to get off the mark.

OUT! STUMPED! A welcome wicket for Sri Lanka! Sabbhineni Meghana steps out and the bowler sees that, this is fired outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to put bat on ball but misses. The keeper does the rest. It is referred but replays show that she is well outside the crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Sugandika Kumari

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, defended.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.

FOUR! Sabbhineni Meghana is in a hurry here! Lucky boundary though! Full, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge past the keeper towards third man for a boundary. 16 runs off the over!
Outside off, this blocked towards cover.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over! Sabbhineni Meghana has come out to bat with positive intent! Fuller, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it past cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Outside off, fullish ball. Sabbhineni Meghana opens the face of the bat and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, full, on middle. Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it out.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Shorter one, down the leg side. Sabbhineni Meghana pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Flatter now, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
Full, on the pads. Sabbhineni Meghana tucks it towards square leg for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Shafali Verma tries to go over once again but holes out this time. An aggressive cameo from her comes to an end. Oshadi Ranasinghe has the last laugh here! Another full ball, around middle. Shafali Verma for the third time steps down and lifts it to the fielder at mid off.  Kavisha Dilhari there pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Kavisha Dilhari b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Outside off, full in length. Shafali Verma once again steps down and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
SIX! Up and over! Fuller, around middle. Shafali Verma advances down the track and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
On middle, Shafali Verma blocks this one.
Wide of off now, fuller ball. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Quicker, outside off, shorter one. Smriti Mandhana tries to cut this one but she misses.
Outside off, fuller one. Smriti Mandhana tries to drive this but she misses.
FOUR! Short, around middle. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls this over square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, shorter ball, Smriti Mandhana cuts it towards short third man.
Full, around middle and leg. Shafali Verma steps down and whips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Deft tough! Outside off, fuller one. Smriti Mandhana opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a boundary.
Slower now, spinning away, outside off. Smriti Mandhana gets an outside edge away from the fielder at short third man.
Shorter now, outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts this one but she misses.
Outside off, fuller one. Smriti Mandhana guides it towards short third man.
On the pads, fuller ball. Shafali Verma tucks it towards square leg.
FOUR! Up and over! A loopy ball, full, around off. Shafali Verma dances down the track and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full in length, outside off. Shafali Verma drives towards long on for a single.
Pitched up delivery, around middle and off. Shafali Verma pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, outside off. Shafali Verma blocks it out.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it through cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana and India Women are up and running in style! Fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives through cover for a boundary.
